profile.name: Matías Nápoli
profile.tagline: I build end-to-end web applications and explore data to solve real-world problems.
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer focused on the JavaScript/React ecosystem, with real-world experience deploying production platforms. Currently studying Data Science and AI, combining software development with data analysis and machine learning.

description: Design, development and deployment of end-to-end responsive web applications using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and React.
Development of production web platforms such as yalotenes.com.ar, nextcell.com.ar, iltanolaino.com.ar and foxtravel-web.vercel.app.
Custom software architecture, including automated quotation engines (Presupuestador) and internal ticketing systems (Ticketeador).
Administration and customization of WordPress websites: hosting, plugins, SEO best practices and performance optimization.
Development of custom functions, automation scripts and workflow criteria using Deluge Script to optimize business and CRM processes.
Configuration, testing and optimization of automation rules, notifications and workflows across modules.
System maintenance, secure data migrations and resolution of critical technical tickets while ensuring high availability.
